label: Shell Access
description: Explore archive logs on a remote server via shell commands to find when and where Rafał was discovered, then submit the date (day before), city and coordinates.

steps.label: Explore /data/
steps.detail: Agent lists and reads log files in /data/ on the remote server

steps.label: AI Analysis

steps.label: Submit Answer
steps.detail: Echo the JSON answer to the remote server for automatic validation and flag retrieval
